title: FHIR Clinical CDR Strategy Configuration
description: MongoDB layout, import, generation, and fhir-mql search settings for the bundled FHIR R5 and R6 packages.

database.description: Required strategy-owned MongoDB database for FHIR resources. Review this value during activation.

schema_version.description: FHIR release supplied by the bundled fhir-gen and fhir-mql packages

collection_prefix.description: Optional prefix for per-resource-type collection names

mode.description: One MongoDB collection per FHIR resource type

max_resources_per_request.description: Safety bound for one Bundle/NDJSON request; larger migrations are chunked by clients

denormalize_on_generate.description: Mandatory invariant: project search and compartment fields before synthetic resources become visible

config_dir.description: Override fhir-mql resource YAML directory; null uses bundled configs

compartment_definitions_dir.description: Override compartment definitions; null uses bundled paths

auto_index.description: Mandatory invariant: ensure resource search indexes before writes

seed.description: Default RNG seed for synthetic generation

use_enrichers.description: Apply fhir-gen enrichers when generating resources

recipes.description: Named generation recipes; merged from specification/recipes.json at load time

enabled.description: Add Kehrnel synthetic meta.tag and extension before MongoDB save

max_count.description: Server maximum result count enforced across all input forms (URL _count, structured, internal ops).

default_count.description: Default page size applied when a request specifies no _count.
